title: marah macrocarpa var. micrantha
intro: Marah macrocarpa var. micrantha, commonly known as the California bugbane or small bugbane, is a plant species in the Cucurbitaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Marah macrocarpa var. micrantha include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
